examples.text:
I've been to hell. I spell it...I spell it DMV
Anyone that's been there knows precisely what I mean
I've stood in line and waited near an hour and fifteen
Girlie, as far as you're concerned, I'm the messiah of the DMV. Now, get out of the car.
examples.ref: 1995, Amy Heckerling, Clueless, spoken by DMV tester (Ron Orbach):

examples.text: The state is currently in the 9EWZ000-9EWZ999 series, and the final plate in the current sequence — 9ZZZ999 — is expected to be issued in late 2025, DMV officials said.
